body_text:
Nested interval theorem. If
$[a_1,b_1]\supseteq[a_2,b_2]\supseteq\cdots$ is a decreasing
sequence of nonempty closed bounded intervals, then their
intersection is nonempty. If $b_n-a_n\to0$, the intersection
contains exactly one point. This is another operational form of
completeness.
